function.name: evaluate_pavement_hydrodynamics
function.description: Calculates real-time pavement water film thickness (WFT), dynamic aquaplaning velocity (V_p), friction coefficient (mu), and sensor perception degradation for autonomous navigation and dispatch agents.

lat.description: Target latitude in decimal degrees (-90.0 to 90.0).

lon.description: Target longitude in decimal degrees (-180.0 to 180.0).

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle profile to adjust tire pressure, contact geometry, and tread depth.

tire_pressure_kpa.description: Optional custom tire pressure in kPa (e.g., 190 for delivery motorbikes, 220 for sedans).

tread_depth_mm.description: Optional remaining tire tread depth in mm (e.g., 1.5 for worn tires, 7.0 for new).

sim_rain.description: Optional simulation override for precipitation intensity in mm/hr for stress-testing wet physics.
